# Burning Springs: Dusty's Treasure Hunt

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 25, 2025
- 4 min read

Updated: Dec 3, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0b878b030c674bd68a0dc4694a38620f~mv2.jpg)

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

The Boss says we got to start making space in the storage house; that means throwing stuff out.

Thing is though, I'm not one for charity.

If you want something, you gotta work for it!

I've hidden 3 keys all around the kingdom. If you find a key, you get to keep whatever's behind the door. Simple and easy.

Good luck!

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ec670c6822d3402b93832f3fca1af3c5~mv2.jpg)

There are four possible spawns for the note mentioned above, so don’t worry if you spot more than one in the area. Collecting duplicates doesn’t unlock anything extra, so grab them if you want to, but you don’t need to pick up every copy.

**Key Location 1**

Fast Travel Point:

- The Rust Kingdom

Directions:

From the spawn in location, run south toward the Deathclaw gate. Stop at the fire barrel on your left and turn east. Walk forward and jump onto the ramp behind the fire barrel. Turn south and follow the ramp all the way to the top until you reach the wall. Turn east and jump up onto the roof above you. Face south and walk to the edge of the roof. Look left and you’ll see a key hanging from one of the spikes on the roof.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5fb375444a794f7ba7496a2b0fd3d299~mv2.jpg)

**Key Location 2**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, face west and jump over to the roof in front of you. Turn south, walk to the end of the roof, and drop down to the ground. Face west again and follow the road straight ahead until it ends. At the bottom of the stairs, turn south and keep following the road. Go through the gates and stop next to the fire truck.

Face east and walk forward slowly. On your left, you’ll see some metal walls that have blown outward. Turn left and head through the gap created by the explosion. Keep to the left and follow the path around the back of the pipe tower. At the rear, there’s a gap between the pipes. Go through it and follow the path to the end. The key is on the skeleton’s shoulder.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a8c69e66cec84916995d5dffb3dac8a8~mv2.jpg)

**Key Location 3**

Fast Travel Point:

- N/A

Directions:

From the spawn above, turn around and follow the path out of the area. Head over to the fire truck and climb up on top of it. Face east and stay on the road. You’ll probably have to open two blue wooden gates as you go, so you can keep following the road. Once you’re through the second gate, you’ll see three Abrax metal barrels sitting on a pallet ahead of you. Turn south. There’s a cage with a Brahmin corpse inside. Step into the cage and look up. The key is hanging from the roof.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a48d59a7f5614c5bbb00a1ea099bbf0d~mv2.jpg)

**Treasure Location**

Level 1 Locked Door

Fast Travel Point:

- The Rust Kingdom

From the spawn in this location, run south toward the Deathclaw gate. Stop at the fire barrel on your left and turn east. Move forward and jump onto the ramp behind the barrel. Turn south and follow the ramp all the way up until you reach the wall.

Turn east and jump up onto the roof above you. Turn south and stop at the edge of the roof. Face east and follow the roofline until you reach the wall of the next metal building.

Turn south again and walk to the edge of the roof. Look up and you’ll see a brick building across from you, slightly to the right. You need to get onto that roof. I can make the jump with a bit of a run-up and a jetpack. If that’s not possible, drop to the ground and climb up the far side instead.

Once you’re on the roof, face south and follow it to the edge. Drop down onto the catwalk below and face west. Take a few steps forward and open the white door on your right.

Inside the room are three numbered doors that match the keys you’ve collected.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_07de5ab0d3f54424a51eda286689b498~mv2.jpg)
